blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The urns submitted by pet owners, who feared they fell victim to a pet crematorium scam, appeared to be filled with “sand” or “cement,” the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) said. This revelation from the NBI came after its previous statement that it discovered no traces of animal remains in the urns turned over to pet owners by Ahjay Paws Aftercare Pet Crematorium in Bacoor City, Cavite. It prompted the bureau to file complaints before the Department of Justice last Nov. 19. READ: PAWS: NBI finds no animal remains in urns linked to crematorium scam In an interview with […]...
